vortex.headline: Following vortex surfaces beyond ideal flow
vortex.headlineZh: 在非理想流动中追踪涡面
vortex.dek: Two questions coincide in an ideal fluid: how particles move, and which velocity preserves a vortex surface. Non-ideal flow separates them.
vortex.dekZh: 在理想流体中有两个问题恰好重合：粒子如何运动，以及哪个速度场能保住涡面。非理想流动把它们分开了。

keypoints.en: Two questions that coincide in ideal flow — how particles move and which velocity preserves a vortex surface — separate once viscosity or other non-ideal terms act. Material transport and vortex transport are not the same thing.
keypoints.zh: 在理想流动中恰好重合的两个问题——粒子如何运动、以及哪个速度场能保住涡面——一旦黏性或其他非理想项起作用就分开了。物质输运与涡量输运并不是同一件事。

keypoints.en: The classical theorems extend to some non-ideal flows when a globally smooth circulation-preserving virtual velocity exists; a vortex-surface field then tracks the surfaces under that velocity instead of the physical one.
keypoints.zh: 当存在一个全局光滑且保持环量的虚拟速度时，经典定理可推广到某些非理想流动；涡面场随后在该速度场、而非物理速度场下追踪涡面。

keypoints.en: Where no globally smooth solution exists, an approximate virtual velocity still improves tracking: in the MHD Taylor–Green flow it better preserves vorticity flux and removes spurious deformation attributable to the Lorentz force.
keypoints.zh: 在不存在全局光滑解时，近似的虚拟速度仍能改善追踪：在 MHD Taylor–Green 流中，它更好地保持了涡通量，并消除了可归因于洛伦兹力的虚假变形。

p: In an ideal fluid, vortex lines are carried by the flow. Helmholtz’s theorems say a vortex surface moves with the fluid, and Kelvin’s circulation theorem says circulation around a material loop is conserved. Together they make vortex surfaces well-defined objects that can be tracked for all time.

Switch on viscosity and both statements fail in the same way and for the same reason: vorticity diffuses, and diffusion breaks the frozen-in property. The usual conclusion is that coherent vortex geometry stops being trackable in a non-ideal flow, and analysis moves to snapshot diagnostics such as Q or λ₂ that identify a vortex at an instant rather than follow one through time.

This paper separates two questions that coincide only in the ideal case: how fluid particles move, and which velocity field, if any, preserves a vortex surface. They have the same answer under the classical assumptions and can have different answers once non-ideal terms act.
pz: 在理想流体中，涡线是被流动携带的。Helmholtz 定理说涡面随流体一起运动，Kelvin 环量定理说沿物质环路的环量守恒。两者合起来，使涡面成为定义良好、可以被全程追踪的对象。
一旦打开黏性，这两个论断会以相同的方式、出于相同的原因失效：涡量发生扩散，而扩散破坏了冻结性质。通常的结论是：在非理想流动中，相干涡结构不再可追踪，分析于是转向 Q 或 λ₂ 这类快照式判据——它们在某一瞬间识别出一个涡，而不是在时间中跟随它。
本文把两个只在理想情形下重合的问题分开：流体粒子如何运动，以及哪个速度场（如果存在的话）能保住涡面。在经典假设下两者答案相同；一旦非理想项起作用，它们可以有不同答案。

p: A material surface is defined by the particles it contains, so it is transported by the physical velocity by definition. A vortex surface is defined by a relation to vorticity — it is everywhere tangent to the vorticity field — and nothing in that definition mentions velocity.

The two coincide in ideal flow because circulation conservation forces vorticity to be transported as though frozen into the fluid. Once that conservation fails, the identification becomes an assumption rather than a consequence, and surfaces defined by vorticity need not move with the particles lying on them.

That distinction is not pedantry. Vortex-surface tracking is used to study reconnection, helicity and the evolution of coherent structures — all questions about how a structure changes in time. If the tracking rule is wrong, an apparent topological change may be an artefact of the observer’s velocity field rather than of the flow.
pz: 物质面由它所包含的粒子定义，因此按定义它被物理速度输运。涡面则由它与涡量的关系定义——它在处处与涡量场相切——而这个定义里完全没有提到速度。
两者在理想流动中重合，是因为环量守恒迫使涡量像被冻结在流体中那样被输运。一旦这个守恒失效，这种等同就从结论退化为假设；由涡量定义的面，未必与位于其上的粒子一起运动。
这个区分不是学究式的讲究。涡面追踪被用于研究重联、螺旋度与相干结构的演化——这些都是关于结构如何随时间变化的问题。如果追踪规则是错的，那么一个看似发生的拓扑改变，可能只是观察者所选速度场的产物，而不是流动本身的产物。

sections.h: A velocity chosen to preserve circulation
sections.hz: 一个为保持环量而被选出的速度
p: The virtual velocity is defined by what it has to conserve. It is a transport field chosen so that circulation — or the vorticity-flux relation standing in for it — is preserved along its flow. It is not an additional physical motion of the fluid.

Because it is not physical, there is no guarantee that it exists. The paper is explicit: the extension holds for non-ideal flows admitting a globally smooth circulation-preserving virtual velocity, and the construction is tested on a modified dissipative flow where an explicit one can be written down and exact tracking becomes checkable.

That test case also prevents vortex-line reconnection, which is the right choice for validation. If reconnection occurs, a vortex surface genuinely changes topology and no tracking rule can preserve it; removing reconnection isolates whether the rule works from whether the structure is being torn.
pz: 虚拟速度由它必须守恒的东西来定义。它是一个被挑选出的输运场，使得环量——或替代它的涡通量关系——沿其流动保持不变。它不是流体的又一种物理运动。
正因为它不是物理的，它并不保证存在。论文说得很明确：该推广适用于那些存在全局光滑、保持环量的虚拟速度的非理想流动；而这一构造在一个修正的耗散流中被检验——在那里可以写出显式解，使精确追踪成为可验证的。
这个检验算例还阻止了涡线重联，这对验证而言是正确的选择。若发生重联，涡面确实会改变拓扑，任何追踪规则都无法保住它；排除重联，就把“规则是否有效”与“结构是否正在被撕裂”这两个问题分离开了。

p: The second setting is harder and more representative: a magnetohydrodynamic Taylor–Green flow, where a globally smooth circulation-preserving velocity is unavailable and an approximate construction has to be used instead.

Comparing transport by physical and virtual velocities is the informative experiment. Where the two differ, the difference says which apparent changes in the surface come from the tracking rule and which come from the vorticity field itself — exactly the question the paper was set up to ask.

In this flow the approximate virtual velocity better preserves vorticity flux and removes spurious deformation attributable to the Lorentz force. That is a specific and useful claim: some of the distortion an observer using the physical velocity would report in an MHD flow belongs to the observer, not to the flow.
pz: 第二个设定更难，也更有代表性：一个磁流体 Taylor–Green 流，其中不存在全局光滑且保持环量的速度，只能改用近似构造。
有信息量的实验是把物理速度与虚拟速度下的输运做对比。两者出现差异的地方，恰恰说明了涡面上哪些表观变化来自追踪规则、哪些来自涡量场本身——这正是本文被设计出来要问的问题。
在这个流动中，近似的虚拟速度更好地保持了涡通量，并消除了可归因于洛伦兹力的虚假变形。这是一个具体而有用的论断：在 MHD 流动中，观察者若使用物理速度，他所报告的一部分变形属于观察者自己，而不属于流动。

p: The contribution is a change in the coordinate system used to follow a structure, not a claim that non-ideal physics disappears. Viscosity still diffuses vorticity, and reconnection still occurs wherever it occurs.

What changes is attribution. A useful virtual transport can preserve a geometric description even when material transport cannot, so questions about vortex-surface evolution stay well-posed in flows where the classical theorems do not apply.

The boundary is existence and smoothness. Where a globally smooth virtual velocity exists the result is exact; where only an approximate one can be built it is an approximation, and the paper does not claim exact frozen-in tracking for arbitrary non-ideal flows. That condition, not the numerical evidence, decides whether the method applies to a given flow.
pz: 这项贡献是更换了用于跟随结构的坐标系，而不是宣称非理想物理消失了。黏性依然在扩散涡量，重联依然在它该发生的地方发生。
改变的是归因。一种有用的虚拟输运可以在物质输运做不到的时候仍然保住几何描述，于是关于涡面演化的问题，在经典定理不适用的流动中依然是适定的。
边界在于存在性与光滑性。存在全局光滑虚拟速度时结果是精确的；只能构造出近似解时它就是近似的——论文并未声称对任意非理想流动都能做到精确的冻结式追踪。决定该方法是否适用于某个流动的，是这个条件，而不是那些数值证据。

magvortex.headline: How vortices change the splitting of magnetic tubes
magvortex.headlineZh: 涡旋如何改变磁通管的分裂
magvortex.dek: A curved magnetic tube splits itself through the dipole it induces. An accompanying vortex can stop that from happening.
magvortex.dekZh: 弯曲的磁管会通过自身诱导的偶极涡自行分裂。而伴随的涡旋可以让这件事不发生。

keypoints.en: A curved magnetic tube generates a Lorentz force and a vortex dipole that can split it into smaller structures — self-induced splitting requiring no external flow.
keypoints.zh: 弯曲的磁管会产生洛伦兹力与涡偶极子，后者可将其分裂成更小的结构——这是一种不需要任何外部流动的自我诱导式分裂。

keypoints.en: The analysis uses a Frenet–Serret frame along field lines, so curvature and torsion give a local language for the forces that bend and separate a tube, and the induced dipole becomes part of the mechanism rather than a flow visualisation.
keypoints.zh: 分析沿磁力线使用 Frenet–Serret 标架，于是曲率与挠率为“使磁管弯曲、分离的力”提供了局部语言；被诱导出的偶极子由此成为机制的一部分，而不只是一种流动可视化。

keypoints.en: Direct numerical simulations of linked magnetic and vortex tubes at initial angles from 0 to 45 degrees show that a sufficiently strong accompanying vortex can disrupt dipole formation and inhibit splitting, with sensitivity to small changes in angular configuration.
keypoints.zh: 对相互链接的磁管与涡管的直接数值模拟（初始夹角 0 到 45 度）表明：足够强的伴随涡旋可以破坏偶极子的形成并抑制分裂，且结果对小幅改变角度很敏感。

p: A curved magnetic flux tube in a conducting fluid does not simply stay as it is. The Lorentz force acting on curved field generates a counter-rotating vortex dipole, and that dipole can tear the tube into smaller structures — a mechanism relevant wherever magnetic structures fragment and release energy.

The clean version of this problem is a magnetic tube alone. Real flows are rarely clean: a magnetic structure in a turbulent conducting fluid sits alongside vortical structures, and the two interact through the same velocity field. Whether the splitting mechanism survives that company is a separate question.

This study asks it with direct numerical simulations of linked magnetic and vortex tubes, varying their initial relative angle from zero to 45 degrees. The answer is conditional and interesting: a sufficiently strong accompanying vortex tube disrupts dipole formation and inhibits splitting.
pz: 导电流体中的一根弯曲磁通管并不会安然保持原样。作用在弯曲磁场上的洛伦兹力会生成一对反向旋转的涡偶极子，而这个偶极子可以把磁管撕裂成更小的结构——在任何磁结构发生碎裂并释放能量的地方，这个机制都值得关注。
这个问题的干净版本是：只有一根磁管。真实的流动很少这么干净：湍流导电流体中的磁结构总是与涡结构并存，而两者通过同一个速度场相互作用。分裂机制能否在这样的陪伴下存活，是一个独立的问题。
本研究用相互链接的磁管与涡管的直接数值模拟来问这个问题，并把它们的初始相对夹角从 0 度变到 45 度。答案是带条件的，也很有意思：足够强的伴随涡管会破坏偶极子的形成，从而抑制分裂。

sections.h: A frame that follows the field line
sections.hz: 一个跟着磁力线走的标架
p: The Frenet–Serret frame attaches a tangent, normal and binormal direction to every point of a curve. Applied to a magnetic field line it converts the geometry of that line — its curvature and torsion — into local coordinates for whatever force acts on it.

This matters because the Lorentz force depends on the field’s own geometry. Curvature determines the direction and magnitude of the magnetic tension force, so expressing the dynamics in the field’s own frame makes the force decomposition readable instead of leaving it buried in components.

In that description the vortex dipole is not a separate observation to be correlated with splitting after the fact. It is the flow response to the tension force, and therefore part of the mechanism — which is why anything that alters the local rotational flow should change whether splitting happens at all.
pz: Frenet–Serret 标架为曲线上每一点附上切向、法向与副法向三个方向。把它用在磁力线上，就把这条线的几何——曲率与挠率——转换成了作用在其上的任何力的局部坐标。
这一点很关键，因为洛伦兹力依赖于磁场自身的几何。曲率决定了磁张力力的方向与大小，因此在磁场自己的标架中表达动力学，能让力的分解变得可读，而不是埋在分量里。
在这个描述下，涡偶极子不再是一个事后拿来与分裂做关联的独立观测。它是流动对张力力的响应，因而是机制的一部分——这正是为什么任何改变局部旋转流动的因素，都应当改变分裂到底会不会发生。

p: The simulations combine an analytical force decomposition with direct numerical simulation of linked magnetic and vortex tubes, varying the initial relative angle from zero to 45 degrees. Field-line geometry, vorticity generation and magnetic-to-kinetic energy transfer are examined together.

Sweeping the angle is the right control because it separates the two structures without changing either one. At zero the tubes are aligned and the vortex sits where the dipole wants to form; as the angle grows, the imposed rotation is progressively misaligned with the self-induced one.

Comparing an isolated magnetic structure with an accompanied one is the other necessary contrast. Without the isolated case you could not tell whether a change in splitting came from the vortex or merely from two structures in a periodic domain evolving differently from one.
pz: 这些模拟把解析的力分解与磁管—涡管链接构型的直接数值模拟结合起来，把初始相对夹角从 0 度扫到 45 度，并同时考察磁力线几何、涡量生成以及磁能向动能的转化。
扫描夹角是正确的控制变量，因为它在不改变两者中任何一个的前提下把它们分离开。夹角为零时，两管对齐，涡旋正好落在偶极子想要形成的位置；夹角增大时，外加的旋转与自我诱导的旋转逐渐错开。
另一个必要的对照是把孤立磁结构与有伴随涡的结构作比较。没有孤立算例，就无法判断分裂的变化究竟来自涡旋，还是仅仅来自周期性域中两个结构本来就与单个结构演化得不同。

p: The isolated magnetic tube behaves as expected. Curvature drives a Lorentz force, the force drives a dipole, and the dipole splits the tube into smaller structures while magnetic energy is converted into kinetic energy.

With a sufficiently strong accompanying vortex tube the outcome changes. The imposed rotational flow disrupts dipole formation before it can organise, and splitting is inhibited rather than merely delayed — the mechanism is interrupted upstream of the step that produces it.

The simulations also show sensitivity to small changes in angular configuration, and that sensitivity is worth reading carefully. A mechanism that depends on how two structures are oriented is one whose outcome in a turbulent flow cannot be predicted from local geometry alone.
pz: 孤立的磁管表现得符合预期：曲率驱动洛伦兹力，洛伦兹力驱动偶极子，偶极子把磁管分裂成更小的结构，同时磁能被转化为动能。
当伴随涡管足够强时，结果就变了。外加的旋转流动在偶极子组织起来之前就破坏了它的形成，分裂被抑制而不仅仅是被推迟——机制在产生它的那一步之前就被截断了。
模拟还显示出对角度小幅改变的敏感性，而这种敏感性值得仔细读。一个依赖于两个结构如何取向的机制，其在一个湍流流动中的结果，就无法仅由局部几何预测出来。

sections.h: From local forces to structural evolution
sections.hz: 从局部的力到结构的演化
p: The result connects a local geometric description — curvature, torsion and the forces they generate — to a visible change in topology and energy release. That chain is the useful part: it explains why a tube splits rather than only recording that it did.

It also argues against treating a magnetic tube independently of its surroundings. In a conducting fluid, magnetic and vortical structures are coupled, and a prediction based on the magnetic structure alone can be qualitatively wrong — here, in the direction of over-predicting fragmentation.

The scope is idealised. These are clean numerical configurations with prescribed initial geometry, chosen to isolate one mechanism. The paper offers a basis for interpreting more complex magnetohydrodynamic flows, not a direct prediction for any particular astrophysical or laboratory configuration.
pz: 这个结果把一种局部的几何描述——曲率、挠率以及它们生成的力——与拓扑和能量释放上的可见变化连接起来。这条因果链才是有用的部分：它解释了磁管为什么分裂，而不只是记录下它分裂了。
它同时也反对把磁管孤立于其周围环境来处理。在导电流体中，磁结构与涡结构是耦合的，仅基于磁结构做出的预测可能是定性错误的——在这里，错误方向是过高估计碎裂程度。
适用范围是理想化的。这些是带有给定初始几何的干净数值构型，目的是分离出某一个机制。论文提供的是解释更复杂磁流体流动的出发点，而不是对任何具体天体或实验室构型的直接预测。

magknot.headline: Watching magnetic field lines tie themselves into knots
magknot.headlineZh: 观察磁力线如何自行打结
magknot.dek: Reconnection changes connectivity, and each event changes the geometry that decides the next one. Following the sequence is the point.
magknot.dekZh: 重联改变连接关系，而每一次事件都会改变决定下一次事件的几何。关键在于跟踪这个序列。

keypoints.en: From two unknotted helical flux tubes of opposite chirality, successive reconnections produce U-shaped loops, then overhand knots, then double overhand and more complex knots — complexity grows stepwise rather than appearing at once.
keypoints.zh: 从两根未打结的、手性相反的螺旋磁通管出发，逐次重联先产生 U 形磁力线，再打成反手结，然后是双反手结与更复杂的结——复杂度是逐步增长的，而不是一次性出现的。

keypoints.en: A magnetic-surface field tracks tube boundaries and identifies reconnection regions, so field lines are followed through events rather than compared between snapshots; knot types are classified by crossing number and Alexander–Briggs notation.
keypoints.zh: 磁面场追踪磁管边界并识别重联区域，因此磁力线是被跟随穿过各次事件的，而不是在快照之间做对比；纽结类型按交叉数与 Alexander–Briggs 记法分类。

keypoints.en: Each reconnection changes the geometry that enables the next: Lorentz-force-driven rotation and stretching rearrange the lines, closing a feedback between geometry and dynamics until resistive and viscous dissipation ends the cascade.
keypoints.zh: 每一次重联都会改变使下一次成为可能的几何：洛伦兹力驱动的旋转与拉伸重新排布磁力线，形成几何与动力学之间的反馈回路，直到电阻与黏性耗散终止这条级联。

p: Magnetic field lines can be knotted, and in a sufficiently conducting fluid that knotting is constrained: reconnection is the only process that changes how field lines are connected. So the question of how complexity arises is really a question about a sequence of reconnection events.

Most studies of magnetic topology compare states — an initial field and a later one — and infer what happened in between. That inference is where the mechanism hides, because a single reconnection event changes the geometry that determines whether the next one can occur.

This work follows two perpendicular helical flux tubes of opposite chirality through the entire sequence. Starting from an unknotted configuration, successive reconnections produce U-shaped loops, then overhand knots, then double overhand and more complex knots: a cascade rather than a single event.
pz: 磁力线是可以打结的；而在电导率足够高的流体中，这种打结受到约束：重联是唯一能改变磁力线连接方式的过程。因此，“复杂性如何产生”这个问题，实际上是关于一系列重联事件的问题。
多数磁拓扑研究比较的是状态——初始的场与后来的场——再反推中间发生了什么。机制恰恰藏在这个反推里，因为单独一次重联事件就会改变决定下一次能否发生的几何。
这项工作跟随两根相互垂直、手性相反的螺旋磁通管走完了整个序列。从未打结的构型出发，逐次重联先产生 U 形磁力线，再形成反手结，然后是双反手结与更复杂的结——这是一条级联，而不是一次事件。

sections.hz: 一次事件为下一次创造条件
p: The first reconnection creates U-shaped field lines. That sounds minor, but it changes how neighbouring lines approach one another, and it is the changed approach geometry that makes the second event possible.

The second reconnection ties overhand knots. By then the field is no longer in the configuration the first event acted on, so describing the outcome as two independent reconnections would misrepresent it — the events are sequential and each is conditioned on the last.

Rotation and stretching driven by the Lorentz force then continue the sequence, producing double overhand knots and more complex types. The driving is not external: the field’s own geometry generates the motion that will reshape that geometry in the next stage.
pz: 第一次重联产生 U 形磁力线。这听起来微不足道，但它改变了相邻磁力线彼此接近的方式，而正是这种改变后的接近几何，使第二次事件成为可能。
第二次重联打出了反手结。此时磁场已经不再是第一次事件作用其上的那个构型，因此把结果描述成两次独立的重联会歪曲事实——这些事件是顺序发生的，每一次都以前一次为条件。
随后，由洛伦兹力驱动的旋转与拉伸延续了这个序列，产生双反手结与更复杂的类型。驱动不是外来的：磁场自身的几何生成了将在下一阶段重塑该几何的运动。

sections.h: Tracking surfaces instead of comparing snapshots
sections.hz: 追踪曲面，而不是比较快照
p: The analysis follows field lines through successive reconnection events rather than relying on snapshots of magnetic intensity. That is a deliberate methodological choice, because intensity fields can look similar across qualitatively different connectivities.

A magnetic-surface field identifies evolving tube boundaries and reconnection regions. Having a surface representation means a tube’s identity can be followed through an event, instead of inferring identity from a field whose connectivity has just changed.

Knot types extracted at different times are compared using crossing number and Alexander–Briggs classification, with energy conversion tracked alongside. This is what links the visual formation of a knot to a quantitative change in topology: the picture and the invariant refer to the same event.
pz: 该分析让磁力线穿过逐次重联事件被跟随，而不是依赖磁场强度的快照。这是一个有意的方法选择，因为强度场在定性上完全不同的连接方式之间可能看起来很相似。
磁面场识别演化中的磁管边界与重联区域。有了曲面表示，一根磁管的身份就可以被跟随穿过一次事件，而不必从一个连接关系刚刚改变的场中去推断身份。
不同时刻提取出的纽结类型用交叉数与 Alexander–Briggs 分类做比较，同时跟踪能量转化。正是这一步把一个结在视觉上的形成与拓扑上的定量改变联系起来——图像与不变量指的是同一次事件。

p: Complexity is quantified through minimum crossing numbers and distributions of knot types, and it increases over time: the population of field lines moves from simple to more complex knot types through the sequence of reconnections.
Knot formation coincides with the conversion of magnetic energy into kinetic energy, which is why the subject matters beyond topology — the same events that complicate the field also release energy.

The cascade eventually slows and stops under resistive and viscous dissipation. That ending is physically necessary: reconnection, and the motions that enable it, both draw on magnetic energy, and dissipation removes both the energy and the small-scale structure the mechanism needs.
pz: 复杂性通过最小交叉数与纽结类型分布被量化，并且随时间上升：磁力线的总体在这串重联序列中从简单类型迁移到更复杂的类型。
纽结的形成与磁能向动能的转化同时发生，这正是该课题超出拓扑学本身的意义所在——使场变复杂的同样是那些释放能量的事件。
这条级联最终在电阻与黏性耗散的作用下减速并停止。这个结局在物理上是必然的：重联本身，以及使重联成为可能的那些运动，都要消耗磁能；而耗散同时带走了能量和该机制所需的小尺度结构。

p: The notable result is directional: complexity grows from an initially unknotted configuration. It would be reasonable to expect reconnection to simplify a tangled field, since it is often described as a release mechanism, and here it does the opposite over the observed sequence.

The feedback is the mechanism. Lorentz-force-driven motion participates in enabling the next reconnection, so geometry shapes dynamics and dynamics reshapes geometry — a loop that can run for several events before dissipation breaks it.

The claim is specific. This is one magnetic-knot mechanism in a resistive flow with one initial condition, not a statement that all reconnection increases knot complexity. Which initial geometries produce cascades and which produce simplification remains open.
pz: 值得注意的是结果的方向性：复杂性从一个最初未打结的构型中生长出来。按常理，人们会预期重联让一个缠结的场变得更简单，因为它常被描述为一种释放机制；而在这里，在观测到的序列中它做的恰恰相反。
反馈就是机制本身。洛伦兹力驱动的运动参与促成下一次重联，于是几何塑造动力学、动力学又重塑几何——这个回路可以跑好几轮事件，直到耗散把它打断。
这个论断是具体的。这是在一次特定初始条件的电阻流动中的一种磁纽结机制，而不是“所有重联都会增加纽结复杂度”的陈述。哪些初始几何会产生级联、哪些会产生简化，仍然是一个开放问题。

vortex-bursting.headline: How opposite magnetic twists trigger vortex bursting
vortex-bursting.headlineZh: 相反的磁扭转如何触发涡爆裂
vortex-bursting.dek: No imposed flow and no initial vorticity — only a magnetic ring whose two halves twist in opposite directions. The eruption comes from the geometry.
vortex-bursting.dekZh: 没有外加流动，也没有初始涡量——只有一根两半扭转方向相反的磁环。爆发来自几何本身。

keypoints.en: No imposed flow and no initial vorticity: the fluid starts at rest and the only structure is a closed magnetic ring whose two halves carry opposite twist, meeting at two chirality-inversion regions.
keypoints.zh: 没有外加流动，也没有初始涡量：流体初始静止，唯一的结构是一根闭合磁环，其两半携带相反的扭转，在两个手性反转区相遇。

keypoints.en: The curl of the Lorentz force is a localized vorticity source peaking at the chirality inversions, while the pressure gradient launches counter-propagating Alfvén waves from the regions of maximum twist; their interaction initiates the bursting.
keypoints.zh: 洛伦兹力的旋度是一个在手性反转区达到峰值的局部涡量源；与此同时，压力梯度从扭转最大处发射出相向传播的阿尔芬波，两者的相互作用触发了爆裂。

keypoints.en: A three-stage process: a disk-like vortex forms as magnetic energy converts to kinetic energy, the structure expands and stretches with dissipation rising, then coherent structures break down through reconnection and fragmentation — with stronger radial spreading at higher Lundquist numbers.
keypoints.zh: 一个三阶段过程：磁能转化为动能、盘状涡结构形成；结构径向扩张拉伸、耗散上升；随后相干结构经重联与碎裂而瓦解——伦德奎斯特数越高，径向扩张越强。

p: Vortex bursting is usually driven. The standard recipe prescribes a perturbation — a core-size change, a differential twist, a nearby boundary — and watches a vortex tube break down. This study removes all of it: no imposed flow, no initial vorticity, a fluid at rest.

What remains is a magnetic field. The initial condition is a closed magnetic ring whose two halves twist in opposite senses, meeting at two chirality-inversion regions. Everything that follows — vorticity, motion, energy release and the eventual breakdown of coherent structures — has to come from that geometry.

That is a strong claim and worth stating precisely: this is a self-contained magnetic route to eruptive dynamics. The simulations trace a three-stage bursting process from a quiescent start. This paper has been accepted for publication in the Journal of Fluid Mechanics.
pz: 涡爆裂通常是被驱动的。标准做法是给定一个扰动——涡核尺寸变化、非均匀扭转、邻近边界——然后观察涡管瓦解。本研究把这些全部去掉：没有外加流动，没有初始涡量，流体静止。
剩下的只有一个磁场。初始条件是一根闭合磁环，其两半以相反方向扭转，在两个手性反转区相遇。此后发生的一切——涡量、运动、能量释放，以及相干结构最终的瓦解——都必须来自这个几何。
这是一个很强的论断，值得被精确表述：这是一条自足的、由磁场通往爆发动力学途径。模拟从静止出发追踪了一个三阶段的爆裂过程。本文已被 Journal of Fluid Mechanics 接受发表。

p: The initial magnetic field is a smooth closed ring with a sinusoidally varying twist, so the two halves twist in opposite senses and meet at two chirality-inversion regions. The velocity is zero everywhere.

The geometry is the experiment. Opposite chiralities guarantee that the magnetic tension force cannot be symmetric about the ring: where the twist reverses, the field’s own geometry produces a stress concentration that a uniformly twisted tube would not have.

Numerically the flow is incompressible magnetohydrodynamics solved with a pseudo-spectral method on a three-dimensional periodic domain at 1024³ resolution and unit magnetic Prandtl number. Three Lundquist numbers, approximately 800, 1600 and 2670, probe the balance between Alfvénic evolution and resistive diffusion.
pz: 初始磁场是一根光滑的闭合磁环，扭转按正弦规律变化，因此两半以相反方向扭转，并在两个手性反转区相遇。速度处处为零。
几何本身就是实验。相反的手性保证了磁张力不可能关于磁环对称：在扭转反向的地方，磁场自身的几何会产生一个均匀扭转磁管所不具备的应力集中。
数值上，这是用伪谱方法在三维周期域上求解的不可压磁流体力学，分辨率为 1024³，磁普朗特数为 1。三个伦德奎斯特数——约 800、1600 与 2670——用于探测阿尔芬演化与电阻扩散之间的平衡。

p: With no initial vorticity, the only source is the curl of the Lorentz force. It is not uniform: its magnitude peaks in the chirality-inversion regions, which is where the first motion appears and where the bursting later initiates.

Meanwhile a second, distinguishable process is running. The pressure gradient generates an antisymmetric cross-helicity distribution in the regions of maximum twist — the signature of counter-propagating Alfvén waves launched from where the twist is strongest.

The mechanism is the interaction of the two. The Alfvén waves travel toward the chirality-inversion regions, where they meet locally generated vorticity and amplify field-line deformation. Bursting therefore emerges from the initial magnetic configuration rather than from any external strain or prescribed vortex.
pz: 在没有初始涡量的情况下，唯一的源是洛伦兹力的旋度。它并不均匀：其幅值在手性反转区达到峰值，那里也正是最初的运动出现、以及稍后爆裂启动的地方。
与此同时，第二个可区分的过程也在进行。压力梯度在扭转最大的区域产生一个反对称的交叉螺旋度分布——这正是从扭转最强处发射出的相向传播阿尔芬波的签名。
机制在于两者的相互作用。阿尔芬波向手性反转区传播，在那里与局部生成的涡量相遇，并放大磁力线的变形。因此，爆裂是从初始磁构型中涌现出来的，而不是来自任何外加应变或预先设定的涡。

p: Stage one is the formation of a disk-like vortex structure — the shape characteristic of vortex bursting — accompanied by rapid conversion of magnetic energy into kinetic energy. This is the stage that connects most directly to the classical bursting literature.

Stage two is radial expansion and stretching, with enhanced magnetic and kinetic dissipation and increasing cross- and kinetic-helicity components. Higher Lundquist numbers produce greater radial spreading and stronger peaks in those components, which is the expected direction: less resistive diffusion lets the Alfvénic dynamics run further before being damped.

Stage three is the breakdown of the organised vortex and magnetic structures — reconnection and fragmentation, with helicity components decaying and dissipation rates declining. The system ends less organised and less energetic than at its peak, which is what an eruptive event should look like.
pz: 第一阶段是盘状涡结构的形成——那正是涡爆裂的特征形态——同时伴随磁能向动能的快速转化。这是与经典爆裂文献联系最直接的一阶段。
第二阶段是径向扩张与拉伸，伴随磁耗散与动能耗散增强，以及交叉螺旋度与动能螺旋度分量的上升。伦德奎斯特数越高，径向扩张越广、这些分量的峰值越强——这正是预期的方向：电阻扩散越弱，阿尔芬动力学在被阻尼之前就能跑得越远。
第三阶段是有组织的涡结构与磁结构瓦解——重联与碎裂，螺旋度分量衰减，耗散率下降。系统最终比其峰值时刻更无序、也更缺乏能量，而这正是一次爆发事件应有的样子。

p: The contribution is a pathway. Starting from a magnetic configuration alone, the simulations produce localized vorticity, propagating Alfvén waves, their interaction, an eruptive breakdown and a return to a dissipated state — a chain that can be checked stage by stage rather than asserted.

That makes it useful for interpretation. Twisted flux tubes appear in solar and laboratory plasmas, and eruptive events there are usually attributed to instabilities or reconnection; this shows a route in which the twist distribution alone organises the onset, with the geometry deciding where it happens.

The limits are the usual ones and the paper states them. The simulations are incompressible, use unit magnetic Prandtl number and run at Lundquist numbers well below those of the solar corona, so this is not a direct reproduction of a solar eruption. The work isolates a mechanism under conditions chosen to make it visible; whether it dominates in a real corona is a separate question.
pz: 这项贡献是一条路径。仅从磁构型出发，模拟就产出了局部涡量、传播的阿尔芬波、两者的相互作用、一次爆发式瓦解，以及回到耗散状态的回归——这条链条可以逐阶段检验，而不是被断言。
这使它对解释观测很有用。扭转磁通管出现在太阳与实验室等离子体中，而那里的爆发事件通常被归因于不稳定性或重联；这项工作展示了一条路径：仅扭转分布本身就组织了爆发的起始，而几何决定了它在哪里发生。
局限是这类工作常见的那些，论文也写明了。模拟是不可压的、磁普朗特数为 1、伦德奎斯特数远低于太阳日冕的实际值，因此这不是对太阳爆发的直接复现。该工作在为使机制可见而选定的条件下把它分离出来；它在真实日冕中是否占主导，是另一个问题。
